{{Quote|Death to the unbelievers!|Canduri|<ref name="OA" />}}
'''Canduri''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Canduri was stationed at a [[S-Ipsus Believers laboratory|Believer laboratory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] at which the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] were developing a [[Anti-Caarite virus|virus]] [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. After the laboratory was raided by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the Caarite-dominated [[Metatheran Cartel]] trading concern, Canduri fled and was captured by a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] who were investigating the Believer operation on Genarius.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Say, is that a survivor you have? We would very much like to purchase her from you.|A Metatheran Cartel soldier, offering to buy Canduri from the heroes of Cularin|<ref name="OA" />}}
Canduri was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and by [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was a young woman. A member of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith-worshipping cult]],<ref name="OA" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the Living Force adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the events depicted in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Open Aarms|Open Aarms]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> Canduri was assigned to a [[S-Ipsus Believers laboratory|hidden Believers laboratory]] sited on [[S-Ipsus]], [[Factory/Legends|manufacturing station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. The S-Ipsus Believer facility hosted an operation by the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] to develop a [[Anti-Caarite virus|virus]] [[Death/Legends|fatal]] to members of the [[Caarite]] [[Species/Legends|species]], though Canduri knew little of the Believers' plans for the contagion. After the [[Metatheran Cartel]]&mdash;a Caarite-dominated trading concern&mdash;learned of the Believer base, a contingent of Cartel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] raided the facility and Canduri was forced to flee.<ref name="OA" />

{{RPG|''[[Metatheran Caution: Open Aarms|Open Aarms]]''}}
While carrying a vial containing a specimen of the anti-Caarite virus, Canduri exited the hidden base via a hatch in the installation's roof and emerged onto a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] production line. There, she immediately crossed paths with the [[heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents investigating the Believer presence on S-Ipsus, who were standing 130 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] away from Canduri as she left the Believer facility and blocking her escape route. In an attempt to get past the freelance agents, Canduri fired a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] at the triggering mechanism for the [[Detonator/Legends|detonator]] production line's security system, in hope that the security defenses would activate and kill the operatives. With the factory's [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] raining down fire, Canduri raced away down the production line but was eventually apprehended by the heroes of Cularin.<ref name="OA" />

Following her capture, Canduri was reticent to reveal any information to the freelance agents. The heroes of Cularin escorted her back to the Believer laboratory to investigate the base and the Cartel soldiers offered to purchase her for the price of 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to each of the operatives. The Cartel troops had planned to take one of the Believers present at the facility as a prisoner for further interrogation and Canduri was the only member of the laboratory's staff to survive the attack; the soldiers therefore considered it imperative that they gain custody of Canduri. The agents declined to surrender the Believer over to the Cartel and departed the laboratory with her.<ref name="OA" />

As the freelance agents attempted to leave the S-Ipsus factory with Canduri, they were intercepted by a patrol of the [[Thaereian military]], an [[Army/Legends|armed force]] [[Thaereian Navy charter|enfranchised]] to defend the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Led by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mish Paht]], the [[Thaereian]]s demanded that Canduri be handed over to them as evidence of the Believers' operation on Genarius. The heroes of Cularin declined to handover their prisoner to the Thaereians and shortly thereafter the agents were ambushed by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] reprogrammed<ref name="OA" /> by the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Melo Centris]]<ref name="BOTB">{{LivingForce|Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast}}</ref> to target the agents. Amid the struggle, Canduri attempted to slip away, but was soon recaptured by the operatives. The heroes of Cularin subsequently transported the Believer off of Genarius and handed her into the custody of the [[Cularin Militia]], a military force that operated on the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="OA" /> Over the following [[Standard day/Legends|days]], Canduri was questioned by her captors on what she know of the Believers' plans for the anti-Caarite virus.<ref name="BOTB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Canduri was of unsound mind and her condition led to her having a want to kill all Caarites, a desire to rule [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and a hatred of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], a noted order of [[The Force/Legends|Force users]]. She was devoted to the Believers though was not willing to fight to the death in support of the Sith cult's cause. Though not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitive]], Canduri convinced herself that she had [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] and when in combat situations would gesture her hands in a futile attempt to [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force grip]] against her opponents. She had [[Color/Legends|dark]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and was [[Language/Legends|multi-lingual]]; in addition to [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]] she was fluent in the languages [[Bothese|Bothan]], [[Caarimala|Caarite]] and [[Rodese/Legends|Rodian]].<ref name="OA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Canduri appeared in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Open Aarms|Open Aarms]]'', a ''[[Star Wars Legends]]'' roleplaying adventure by [[Morrie Mullins]] and published in [[2003]] that served as the second instalment of the [[Metatheran Caution trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] roleplaying campaign.<ref name="OA" /> She was subsequently referenced in ''[[Metatheran Caution: Belly of the Beaast|Belly of the Beaast]]'', the final module of the Metatheran Caution trilogy.<ref name="BOTB" />

===Possible roleplaying outcomes===
In ''Open Aarms'', the players roleplay as the heroes of Cularin and various outcomes are possible based on the actions and decisions of the players. It is possible for Canduri to either be captured or killed by the freelance agents when she encounters the operatives while fleeing the S-Ipsus Believers laboratory. The adventure advises that in the event that Canduri is killed, a new Believer character should be inserted into the adventure and captured by the player characters to fulfill the role otherwise played out by Canduri.<ref name="OA" />

There are also various possible eventualities regarding Canduri's fate subsequent to her capture. It is possible firstly for the player characters to relinquish her the Metatheran Cartel soldiers that raided the Believer laboratory, in which case the troops offer 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to each of the freelance agents to purchase her but a higher purchase price of up to 500 credits can be negotiated. It is alternatively possible for the Canduri to be seized by the Thaereian patrol commanded by Lieutenant Mish Paht or for the player characters to voluntarily surrender her to the Thaereians. When the freelance of agents are attacked by battle [[Droid/Legends|droids]] reprogrammed<ref name="OA" /> by Melo Centris,<ref name="BOTB" /> Canduri attempts to run free and if she succeeds at escaping she is then captured by the Metatheran Cartel soldiers and taken away.<ref name="OA" />

After leaving S-Ipsus, if the player characters still have custody of Canduri they can choose to hand her over to various different groups. It is possible for Canduri to be surrendered to the Jedi Order, in which case the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] takes custody of her. Qel-Bertuk then plans to have the Jedi question her and hands her into the charge of the Cularin Militia. It is also possible for the freelance agents to relinquish Canduri to the Cularin Militia directly. An alternative recourse is for the operatives to take her to a group of researchers studying the anti-Caarite virus from a [[S-Ipsus orbital research facility|research facility]] orbiting S-Ipsus, though the [[Scientist/Legends|research team]] are reticent to take her and suggest that the freelance agents hand her to the Cularin Militia or the [[Office of Peace and Security]] law enforcement agency instead. Another possibility is that the player characters take Canduri to the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]; Nirama is resistant to accepting the captive Believer and if the player characters are insistent to him taking her then he accepts her and arranges for her to be transferred somewhere more appropriate.<ref name="OA" /> In ''Belly of the Beaast'', it is noted that if Canduri was captured during the events of ''Open Aarms'', she was subsequently questioned by her captors for information concerning the virus.<ref name="BOTB" />
